transcript.text:
Try these safe checks first:

1. Check power
• Make sure it’s plugged in securely.
• Test the outlet with another appliance.
• Check your breaker/GFCI outlet hasn’t tripped.

2. Check the door
• Ensure the door closes fully and nothing is blocking the latch.
• A microwave will not run if its door switches aren’t engaging.

3. Reset it
• Unplug it for 1–2 minutes, then plug it back in.
• Reset the clock if needed and test with a microwave-safe cup of water.

4. Look for obvious issues
• If the display is on but it won’t heat, stop using it—it may have a failed magnetron, diode, fuse, or door switch.
• If it sparks, smells burnt, makes unusually loud buzzing, or has visible internal damage, unplug it immediately.

Do not open the microwave casing yourself. Microwaves contain high-voltage components that can remain dangerous even after being unplugged.

If you tell me what it does—e.g., completely dead, runs but doesn’t heat, sparks, door won’t latch, error code—I can help narrow down the likely cause.
its plugged in and the display is on, shows the time. beeps when I press buttons but won't start

If the display works and buttons beep but it will not begin a cook cycle, the most common causes are a door-latch/switch issue or a control lock setting.

Try this:

1. Set a short cook time
   Enter `0:30`, then press Start. Make sure it is in microwave cook mode, not just a kitchen timer.

2. Close the door firmly
   Open and close it again, pressing gently near the latch side as you press Start. Check for crumbs, grease, or anything stopping the door from fully closing.

3. Check for Control Lock / Child Lock
   Look for a padlock icon or “LOCK” on the display. On many models, holding Stop/Cancel, Clear, or sometimes Start for about 3 seconds toggles the lock—but check the label/manual for your model.

4. Power reset
   Unplug it for 2 minutes, plug it back in, reset the clock if necessary, and retry.

If it still only beeps and never starts—especially if pressing Start gives a beep but no interior light, fan, or turntable movement—the door interlock switch/latch assembly is likely faulty. It needs appliance service; don’t remove the outer cover yourself because microwaves can retain dangerous high voltage even unplugged.

If you share the brand/model and exactly what happens after you enter a time and press Start (any message, one beep vs several beeps, lock icon), I can give model-specific steps.
theres a little L symbol on the display. its a Samsung. how do i get rid of it?

The “L” means Child Lock is on.

On most Samsung microwaves:

1. Press and hold Start / +30 Sec for about 3 seconds.
2. The microwave should beep and the L should disappear.

Then try setting a time and pressing Start again.

If holding Start does not work, try holding Stop/Eco, Stop/Cancel, or Clear for 3 seconds instead—Samsung uses a different button on some models.
ok, which button do i hold? start or stop? it's not saying on it

Hold Start first — the button that also may say “+30 Sec” — for about 3 seconds.

You should hear a beep and the L should disappear.

If that does nothing, hold the Stop/Cancel button for 3 seconds instead. Don’t hold both at once.
held start and nothing happened, the L stayed. then I held stop for 3 secs and the L's gone and it works now
Great — it was the child/control lock. On your Samsung, hold Stop/Cancel for about 3 seconds to toggle it on or off.
